'''Makintay''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]].

==Biography==
When the planet's rich mineral deposits, including [[coralline]] and [[ostrine]], were discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they subjugated the world and made the local ruler, Makintay, Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]].
